text: Looks like you're assembling a construction-toy car. Want me to walk you through it?
Pick up the front chassis piece and set it onto the front end of the base frame, lining its holes up with the holes in the frame.
Take a chassis pin and push it through the aligned holes of the front chassis and base frame until it is fully in.
Pick up the long rear chassis and set it on the rear end of the base frame so both of its pin holes line up with the frame holes.
Pick up the long rear chassis, not the short one.

substeps: Pick up the long rear chassis, not the short one.
Lower it onto the rear end of the base frame.
Line up both pin holes with the frame holes.
detail.parts_line: You'll need: rear chassis, base frame.
detail.where: top-down over the rear end of the base frame

text: Pick up the front wheel assembly.

substeps: Pick up the front wheel assembly.
Line its axle up with the front chassis mount.
Push it straight in until it stops.
Check both wheels sit level and spin.
detail.parts_line: You'll need: front wheel assembly, front chassis.
detail.where: front of the car at wheel height, then from above to check both sides

substeps: Place it on the mounting face of the front chassis.

Hold it flat against the chassis.
